INSCRYPTION-SIDE_DECK.title: Side Deck
INSCRYPTION-SIDE_DECK.description: At the start of your turn, add a [gold]Squirrel[/gold] to your hand ([blue]{Cards}[/blue] per combat). Whenever one of your creatures dies, gain 1 [gold]Bones[/gold].
INSCRYPTION-SIDE_DECK.flavor: Ten of them, and none of them mind.
